### [component] Glowing Card  [id: 5328]
by ravikatiyar162
A sleek, glassmorphic stat display card with a subtle glowing effect that highlights the featured metric. The card uses soft light streaks, rounded corners, and a dark translucent background to create a modern, futuristic look. Perfect for dashboards, analytics tools, and live data displays to showcase key stats like views, likes, or revenue in an eye-catching way.
preview: https://cdn.21st.dev/ravikatiyar162/glowing-card/default/preview.1755200622157.png
install: npx shadcn@latest add "https://21st.dev/r/ravikatiyar162/glowing-card?api_key=$API_KEY_21ST"
→ get the code: get_component({ id: 5328 })
